sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in a case registered for offence under Section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per prosecution case, the F.I.R. named accused persons including this petitioner committed rape upon the victim (informant).
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
The medical report does not support the prosecution case.

According to opinion of Doctor,
"No evidence of deposition of semen inside vagina within 48-72 hrs.".
Learned counsel further submits that during trial, the informant (victim), who was examined as P.W.-2, has deposed that she did not recognize this petitioner and other two co-accused persons.

She also deposed that this petitioner has not committed rape upon her (copy of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.82012 of 2024(3) dt.11-04-2025 deposition is at Annexure - A to the supplementary affidavit).
Petitioner has got clean antecedent and is in custody since 20.08.2024.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State vehemently opposed the bail petition.
